positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: SOL is the clearest mover on an otherwise flat tape. It bounced from the low-$70s (~73.5) to 76.41 overnight — the strongest relative strength in the majors — and is pressing directly into the $77-$78 resistance/pivot; a clean break opens room to run. Canonical dashboard proxy was FRESH this run (asOf 2026-08-09T11:40:58Z): SOL 76.41, BTC 64939.19, ETH 1919.07.
positions.driver: Closed prior ETH at 1919.07 (canonical live) vs entry 1918.99 for +0.45 (+0.00%) — ETH is dead money, consolidating in a razor-tight range with ETF inflows still not translating into price. ROTATED into SOL as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick: it owns the only real momentum/relative-strength signal on the tape (up ~4% overnight, testing the $77-78 pivot) and offers an asymmetric payoff if it clears resistance. Wins vs runners-up: ETH (1919) has the flow catalyst but zero price traction — repeatedly flat; BTC (~64.9k) is the safe major with the strongest ETF inflows (5 straight days, ~$850M) but is drifting sideways with no near-term edge. SOL is where the actual move is, with a definable higher-beta stop.
positions.risks: SOL carries the highest beta of the three and — unlike BTC/ETH — has NO ETF flow support (all six US SOL ETFs logged ~5 straight sessions of zero/negative net flows), so the move is momentum-only and can reverse fast. Broad sentiment is still in fear (F&G ~39). If the $77-78 pivot rejects, expect mean reversion toward the low-$70s. Hard stop 68.00 (-11%).
